from.place: Proof paragraph *1*, sentence: Fpqc coverings of schemes satisfy the three axioms: isomorphisms, composites, and arbitrary base changes.

title: Fpqc coverings satisfy the site covering axioms
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Then: (1) for any isomorphism $T^\prime\to T$, the singleton family $\{T^\prime\to T\}$ is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]; (2) if $\{T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ is an fpqc covering and, for every $i$, $\{T_{ij}\to T_i\}_{j\in J_i}$ is an fpqc covering, then $\{T_{ij}\to T\}_{i\in I,j\in J_i}$ is an fpqc covering; (3) if $\{T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ is an fpqc covering and $T^\prime\to T$ is any scheme morphism, then $\{T^\prime\times_T T_i\to T^\prime\}_{i\in I}$ is an fpqc covering, with fibre products as in [def-pc-fibre-product].
